program.section_heading: Basic Internet Skills Certificate of Completion
outcomes: Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to apply different search techniques and methods while accessing a variety of search engines.
Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to demonstrate how to send and receive e-mail, insert attachments, and edit text within the email.
Upon successful completion of the program, the student will be able to demonstrate the basics of editing images in an image editing platform.
